info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Healthcare Appointments Notes-v2-spec
info.description: This API allows users to retrieve notes associated with healthcare appointments, facilitating better management of patient information. It provides access to detailed notes for particular appointments, which can be crucial for healthcare providers needing to review past interactions or treatment details. Typical consumers include healthcare providers, administrative staff, and electronic health record systems. This functionality supports improved patient care by enabling comprehensive access to appointment histories and enhancing collaboration among team members.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch all notes linked to their appointments, providing essential information for better management and tracking of appointment-related details.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve notes associated with appointments. The client can specify criteria to filter the results based on various attributes.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of appointment notes.

ListHealthcareAppointmentsNotesRequest.description: Represents the request body for retrieving appointment notes.
